note: Route-level consent phrases, keyed "<METHOD> <family> <template>" (heads spec 01 §7.2). Consent is authorised per ROUTE, not per method: several headless methods can share one route, and the server cannot tell them apart, so the dialog must describe the union of what the route can do. scripts/generate-bridge-allowlist.mjs fails on a write row whose apis map to different method verbs unless that route appears here, fails on an entry here that matches no route, and a `{n}` placeholder is only accepted on bulk methods.

verbs.DELETE app /api/app/projects/{project_id: delete a custom event or event definition
delete ALL matching schemas in this project
verbs.PATCH app /api/app/projects/{project_id}: change a dashboard: its settings or which reports are on it
verbs.POST app /api/app/projects/{project_id}/: register a lookup table or mark one ready
create or delete a Lexicon tag
verbs.PUT app /api/app/projects/{project_id}/b: replace or clear this project's business context
